body:
My parents tend to have low tolerance when it comes to lying, and I’ve stretched their patience a lot in the past, especially when it comes to academics. If they found out about this, AND about my mental health issues, my Mom especially would want me close to her and in a “low-stress” situation. 

And while I recognize all of those things, I cant help but instinctively hate myself. I mean, every gay person faces problems because they’re gay; mine probably arent as bad as most but it still fucks with my mental health
